title: Hysteresis loop parameters schema
description: Parameters read from a hysteresis loop, each combined over the loops measured at one field condition. Voltages are in the loop's xAxis units, responses in its yAxis units

imprint.description: bias at the centre of the loop: half the sum of the two coercive voltages

coerciveVoltage.description: bias at which the response crosses the loop's offset, on the rising and the falling branch

loopWidth.description: bias separation of the two coercive voltages

loopHeight.description: response separation of the two remanent responses

remanentResponse.description: response at zero bias, on the rising and the falling branch
